services.title: Upholstered furniture restoration
services.lead: Keep its character. Restore its comfort.
services.body:
Sagging seats, uneven support and a loose frame can have different causes. We assess the filling, springs, support and accessible parts of the frame, then agree which elements need repair or replacement.

Replacing the outer fabric alone will not correct every underlying problem. We discuss the condition of the furniture and the required work before choosing the final finish.
services.detail: Older and unusual pieces may need an inspection before the final estimate. Hidden wear can become visible during dismantling, so any additional work should be agreed before it is carried out. Photographs in the archive document real projects; their materials and scope are not a fixed offer for another piece.
services.seoTitle: Upholstered furniture restoration in Warsaw — Klim & Co
services.seoDescription: Repair of furniture filling, springs and frames in Warsaw. Discuss the condition of your sofa or armchair and an individual scope of restoration.

services.title: Made-to-measure covers
services.body: We design and sew removable covers for sofas, armchairs, chairs and mattresses, taking the furniture’s shape, removal and fabric properties into account.
services.detail: We discuss the cover’s construction, fastenings and finish. Cleaning instructions depend on the chosen fabric. Whether it can be washed, and how, must be checked against that material’s care guidance.
services.seoTitle: Made-to-measure sofa and armchair covers in Warsaw — Klim & Co
services.seoDescription: Removable covers for sofas, armchairs, chairs and mattresses. Individual fitting by Oleg Klimko’s Klim & Co workshop in Warsaw.

services.title: Mechanisms and upholstered details
services.body:
We discuss repairs or replacement of sofa-bed mechanisms where suitable parts and the furniture’s construction allow it. We also sew cushions, bolsters, mattresses and individual upholstered elements to agreed dimensions.

These are different tasks: a mechanism needs a compatibility check, while a cushion needs accurate dimensions, suitable filling and a cover. Photographs and a clear description help identify the appropriate next step.
services.detail: A photograph alone cannot confirm mechanism compatibility. If accessible, include the model or markings and show the furniture in both positions. Do not force a jammed mechanism. For cushions, describe the required firmness, thickness and whether the cover needs to be removable. Availability, cost and timing are agreed individually.

materials.name: Velvet
materials.text: A soft surface and rich colour. We consider pile direction, care and the properties of the specific fabric.

materials.name: Jacquard
materials.text: A distinctive weave and pattern, suited to furniture whose texture is part of its character.

materials.name: Chenille
materials.text: Textured yarn and a pleasant feel. Collections differ in composition and performance; we check the sample and the manufacturer’s guidance.

materials.name: Woven upholstery fabric
materials.text: A visible weave and even geometry that emphasise a simple shape and colour.

materials.name: Leather
materials.text: A distinctive feel and natural grain. Material quality, cutting and suitable care all matter.

materials.name: Faux leather
materials.text: An even surface and a wide choice of colours. Durability and care depend on its composition and conditions of use.
